caption:
someone could be making scam calls on a SIM in your name and you'd never know.

open sancharsaathi.gov.in, go to Know Your Mobile Connections and log in with your number and an OTP. it lists every connection on your ID: mark unknown ones Not my number and old ones Not required.

how many numbers showed up on yours? just the number.

Comment SIM and I'll DM you the official link, the exact steps and what to do if a number isn't yours.
